## Purpose and relevant authority
Describe the scope and cite the charter/protocol/role authorization. A PR does **not** itself ratify a rule.

## Change and alternatives
What changes, and why? What simpler and competing approaches were considered? What would be lost or made harder?

## Human and agent experience
How does a person enter through GitHub, understand the work, object, edit and trace the result? How does an agent recover from root + issue/PR?

## Evidence and verification
Record exact test commands, relevant job URLs, human/agent integration runs, expected and observed outputs, remaining limitations.

## Dependencies and reconciliation
Which indexes, discussions, roles, skills, prior decisions, references and in-flight tasks are affected? Who verifies their update?

## Decision requested
State proposal status, appropriate reviewer and exact intended effect. A favorable review of a draft is not automatic authority to amend the charter.
